tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background, paper.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Nav, cards, TOC, component panels.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset panels, table header and hover, highlighted ladder step.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, component labels, stress box borders, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and metadata. Noir: surface-0 and surface-1 only, never surface-2.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Headings, accents, active states, dragonmark borders. Text on any surface.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Hover and emphasis (em) text on any surface.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Fills and borders. Noir: text on surface-0 only.

tokens.name: blue-bright
tokens.usage: Links, h3, code text, focus rings, on any surface.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Fills and borders for consequences, danger, failure. Not text on noir.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Text for consequences, failure, danger, on any surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative borders and dividers. Not for control borders (too faint).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadows.

tokens.name: paper-news
tokens.usage: Korranberg Chronicle stock. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-letter
tokens.usage: House letterhead stock; text on the wax seal. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-slip
tokens.usage: Sending message slip stock. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-poster
tokens.usage: Wanted poster stock. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-print
tokens.usage: Text on any paper token.

tokens.name: ink-print-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on any paper token.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: Seals, stamps, poster reward line. Text on any paper token.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gaps between boxes, tight label spacing.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Component inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing, component inner padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding, block margins.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Section padding, stat block margins.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Space above headings, between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Art deco corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Site cards, code, tables, refresh cost tags.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Fate dice faces, consequence shift circles, seals, countdown dials.
